Macle Open Platform — Developer Documentation for Telebirr MiniApps

Official Guide, Component Library, API Reference, and DevSuite for Telebirr SuperApp Mini Programs

Macle is the official mini-program framework and runtime engine powering Telebirr SuperApp MiniApps (Ethio Telecom). It enables developers to build high-performance, native-speed mini programs using both Native MAML (MiniApp Markup Language) and Taro 3.x React. Explore our complete component library, Telebirr payment and device APIs, and interactive Web Simulator.
